text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Sweep Tosho brings me along on a search for new magic ideas, when…

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho! I just thought of a new spell! Would you mind taking a look at it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A new spell? But this is just a letter!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: It's not just a letter! I put an enchantment on it. When you expose it to a life source, words appear!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, we can't just sit here! Let's go, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Ergh, why?! No matter how much light I shine on it or how much I beg Sylph, nothing shows up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Light nurtures life, wind carries seeds… They're both life sources! I don't know what the heck else w—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she says that, a somewhat familiar woman walks right up to us.
choice_data_list: Hey, it's the woman from earlier…

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm so thirsty. I think I'll have myself a sip of water from my trusty water bottle!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp, gulp… Phew! Just what the doctor ordered! Water really is the source of all life!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The source of all… That's it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho rushes to the river and splashes water on the letter.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ooh! There's letters! Letters are appearing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Um… "I'm always rooting for you. Good luck in your next race!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I can't believe she went through all the trouble of writing me a magic letter!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Talk about dedication! That's what a true fan of the genius Magical Girl Sweepy looks like!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm not about to be outdone! I need to cast an awesome spell back and show her just how different our powers are!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, Familiar! Let's head back and get studying! Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Oooh, she's going to cast me a spell back! I'm glad I thought so hard about my letter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho seems enthusiastic. The love of her fans really might be its own magic.
